status_summary: No transfer of NTIS functions to NIST and no consolidation with technology transfer programs was found since 2025-01-20. The FY2026 NIST and NTIS budget submission shows NTIS as a separate unit, and NTIS already works under the policy guidance of the Under Secretary for Standards and Technology under a 2020 Commerce order that predates the period. On 2026-09-30 NTIS published a Federal Register request for information on digitizing and modernizing the National Technical Reports Library, signed by the NIST Executive Secretariat under a NIST docket; it does not mention a transfer and points toward continuing NTIS as a separate service.

timeline.event: A Federal Register request for information on digitizing and modernizing the National Technical Reports Library is published for NTIS, signed by the NIST Executive Secretariat; comments are due 2026-11-16. The notice does not mention moving NTIS to NIST.
